newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials steady to firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials steady to firmer.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials were steady to firmer in moderate action Monday, with a number of deals heard done.
Prompt airline-quality 54-grade barrels traded in New York Harbor at 3.30 cents over August futures.
In Houston, prompt 54-grade was heard done at 0.35 and 0.40 cent over September futures, now the benchmark for prompt material in Houston.
The low sulphur 55-grade was meanwhile steady in both New York Harbor and Houston markets, traders said.
